# coincides with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coincidesWith`](gmeow-coincidesWith.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coincidesWith>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

Allen EQUALS: this event and the related event share the same temporal extent (co-temporal). Symmetric and transitive. Asserts TEMPORAL simultaneity only, never identity of the events themselves. (= [time:intervalEquals](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalEquals); TimeML SIMULTANEOUS; TEO equal.)
